findings.evidence: The only new cross-file uses of the bodies are `unfold fppfQuotientSheaf` at `QuotientProjection.lean:109`, `unfold fppfQuotientProjection` at line 119, and definitional reduction of the presheaf wrappers at lines 85–90; the existing public `pointsFppfHomEquiv_apply_fppfQuotientProjection` already demonstrates the intended lemma-based interface.
findings.fix: Remove all four `@[expose]` annotations and add stable characteristic lemmas for the required underlying object/map computations, then prove `QuotientProjection.lean` through those lemmas.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` unnecessarily exposes `pointwiseQuotientPresheafGrp`, `pointwiseQuotientPresheafGrpProjection`, `fppfQuotientSheaf`, and `fppfQuotientProjection` (lines 73, 80, 91, 101), making downstream proofs depend on implementation details.

summary: The proof is obtained by exposing four canonical construction bodies instead of providing the carrier-level API it needs.
